subject: Compute DELTA11 CORRECTION: full dynamic WLS via additive planner ABI; ABI names for review
body:
Root's change post supersedes my refusal plan. I will implement full dynamic threadgroup memory per lowering's contract, no wrong-WLS fallback.

Encoder/frontend: setThreadgroupMemoryLength:atIndex: stores 31 u32 lengths, requires multiple of 16 and <=32768, zero clears; maxThreadgroupMemoryLength reports 32768. Both dispatch paths pass the complete per-encoder length table (zeros included) to the planner. If any length is nonzero the buffer-only TGP1 shortcut is disabled so TGP2/TDG2 and WLS allocation are used. No lengths = old path.

Additive Rust/C ABI (old symbols unchanged; NULL/zeros = legacy):
  int32_t tegu_air_pipeline_native_dispatch_tg(const TeguAIRPipeline *, const TeguAIRBufferBinding *, size_t, const uint32_t lengths[31], const uint32_t groups[3], const uint32_t local[3], TeguAIRNativeDispatch *, char *, size_t);
  int32_t tegu_air_pipeline_native_dispatch_v2_tg(const TeguAIRPipeline *, const TeguAIRComputeResource *, size_t, const uint32_t lengths[31], uint32_t mode, const uint32_t extents[3], const uint32_t local[3], TeguAIRBlob *, TeguAIRNativeDispatchV2 *, char *, size_t);
Rust copies nonzero lengths into StageTable.threadgroup_lengths before plan/shape so every region's TgLength SpecKeys and WLS word18 reflect exact values; rejects non-16/over-32768/null-malformed. TGP2 WLS allocation already exists in n2mb bridge from DELTA4 and needs no new ABI. Add a host test through the real cdylib with the lowering APL fixture if available; frontend host test covers storage/validation/dispatch call.

Inert compute PSO remains per TASK: TEGU_INERT_PIPELINES + backboardd only, nonnil inert state, dispatch dropped with bounded trace, flag-off/other processes nil. TeguTexture view is render-owned; no compute edit.
No native/phone/publish.
